issues.body: `cmd_reason` still prints `usage: sparq-cli reason <data-file> <format> <rdfs|owl|n3> [out.nt]` even though `el` is now accepted, and the top-level fallback still omits both the existing `reason` command and feature-gated `classify`. Since `skills/cli/SKILL.md` explicitly says there is no `--help` and users discover commands through these usage errors, the executable's discovery output contradicts the public surface. The new tests do not exercise either path.
issues.fix_hint: Add `el` to `cmd_reason`'s missing-argument usage. Add `reason` to top-level usage and conditionally advertise `classify <data-file> <format> [out.nt]` under `reason-el`. Add subprocess assertions for `reason` with missing arguments and for feature-enabled top-level usage.
issues.title: The no-help CLI still omits EL surfaces from its usage contract

verdict.summary: Round 4 is stagnant: the sole round-3 finding remains unchanged. The feature-enabled CLI still accepts `reason ... el` and dispatches `classify`, but its built-in discovery contract remains stale: `cmd_reason` advertises only `<rdfs|owl|n3>`, while the top-level usage omits both `reason` and feature-gated `classify`. This is especially material because the documented CLI intentionally provides no `--help`. The added tests cover classify's own missing-argument text and the unknown-profile list, but not either stale usage path. The EL result-path test is otherwise end-to-end and consistent with the scoped completeness argument in `research/owl2-el-ql-reasoning-spike.md`.
